_note: Regression floor for the LIVE chatbot eval (scripts/check_regression.py against the metrics from `eval_chatbot.py --live`, run locally with the OpenAI key; the per-question cache makes re-runs deterministic & free). Observed on gpt-5-mini: tool_selection 18/18, answer_correctness 18/18, refusal 5/5 = 100% overall. Floors are set BELOW the observed number with a tolerance band because the model layer is non-deterministic (unlike the cached, deterministic answer check in baseline.mock.json). Refresh deliberately together with metrics.json when the set grows or the tool surface changes. Reuses the extraction baseline schema so check_regression.py is shared verbatim.
